title: Engineering Higher-order Effective Hamiltonians
summary: Advancing quantum technologies requires precise and robust coherent control of quantum systems. Robust higher-order Hamiltonian engineering is essential for high-precision control and for accessing effective dynamics absent at zeroth order. Here, we introduce a systematic methodology for achieving the precision, robustness, and complexity required for quantum control through the engineering of higher-order processes and effective Hamiltonians. We identify the minimal subspace of achievable effective Hamiltonian at each order and provide universal cost functions for achieving desired targets.…
